title: Partite matchings and codes
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $k$, consider the complete multipartite graph with $2r$ parts, each containing $k$ vertices. There is an equivalence between its perfect matchings and recursive pairing codes of length parameter $(2rk)/2$ whose decoded pairs join vertices from different parts.
